scripts.build: npm run fixtures && npm run bundle && cd web && trunk build index.html --release --dist ../dist --skip-version-check --locked=true
scripts.format:check: prettier --check eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json scripts/qa/*.mjs tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts package.json QA.md AGENTS.md TESTING.md PERFORMANCE.md .github/workflows/*.yml .github/actions/setup-rudiment/action.yml
scripts.perf:fast: npm run build && npm run perf:fast:measure
scripts.perf:fast:measure: node scripts/performance/run.mjs --tier fast --output performance-results/fast.json && node scripts/performance/compare.mjs tests/performance/baseline.json performance-results/fast.json --enforce && node scripts/performance/report.mjs --current performance-results/fast.json --baseline tests/performance/baseline.json --output performance-results/fast.md
scripts.perf:full: npm run build && node scripts/performance/run.mjs --tier full --output performance-results/full.json && node scripts/performance/report.mjs --current performance-results/full.json --baseline tests/performance/baseline.json --output performance-results/full.md
scripts.perf:endurance: npm run build && node scripts/performance/run.mjs --tier endurance --output performance-results/endurance.json
scripts.perf:trace: npm run build && node scripts/performance/run.mjs --tier full --trace --output performance-results/full-trace.json
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked && npm run build
